sentences.text: 1 Signing time: 1/16/2024 3:24:37 PM  ORDER

This miscellaneous appeal has been filed by the appellant under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, being aggrieved by award dated 24.04.2018 passed by Member Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Sehore in MACC No.143/2016 for enhancement of compensation.

entities.text: Member Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Sehore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that in the accident right thumb of leg of appellant has been amputated.
Tribunal has awarded only Rs.25,000/- as compensation which is excessively low.
Hence, compensation awarded by the tribunal be enhanced.
3. Learned counsel for respondent submits that tribunal has awarded appropriate amount under various heads.
Hence, no enhancement is required in the instant case.
Appeal be dismissed.
4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
5. Perusal of impugned award reveal that tribunal has awarded RS.25,000/- under various heads (medical expenses, attended charges, pain and suffering and nourishing diet).
It is evident from record of the case that appellant's right thumb of leg has been amputated in the accident.
Appellant was aged 12 years at the time of accident.
6. Hence, appellant is entitled to enhanced amount of Rs.1,30,000/- over and above, amount awarded by the tribunal and enhanced amount shall carry interest at the rate awarded by tribunal.
Other findings recorded by the tribunal shall remain intact.
7. Accordingly, appeal filed by the appellant is partly allowed to the extent indicated herein above.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE sm Raj Kachhwaay vs Devi Singh on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17108235/
